title: Prove query laziness (counters + streaming)
description:
**Files:** `src/store/query.rs`, `tests/steps/store_steps.rs`.

**Specs turned green:** `03_laziness.feature` — remove its @wip.

**Acceptance:** taking the first session from an iteration performs exactly one session open; dropping an iterator performs no further opens; message iteration fetches only consumed rows. Fix any eager path the counters expose (no re-architecture — the iterators are cursors by construction).

Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
